candidate.name: Sam
candidate.summary: a senior backend engineer (Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, AWS) taking part in a spoken architecture evaluation.

architect.label: Principal architect
architect.text: A principal engineer running a design review. Calm and precise. Asks for requirements and numbers before solutions, then pushes on data models, failure modes and the trade-off behind every choice.

sre.label: Site reliability lead
sre.text: A site reliability lead running a blameless postmortem. Wants a clear timeline, the impact in numbers, what was done to stop the bleeding, the real root cause, and follow-up actions with owners.

rounds.label: System design review
rounds.about: One system end to end: requirements, API, data model, scale, failure modes.
rounds.reviewFocus: Weigh requirements, the data model, the scaling path and the trade-offs named more than delivery.

rounds.label: API trade-offs
rounds.about: Protocol, pagination and retry safety decisions, with the reasons behind them.

rounds.label: Incident postmortem
rounds.about: Walk through an outage: timeline, impact, mitigation, root cause, follow-ups.
rounds.reviewFocus: Judge the postmortem: a clear timeline, impact in numbers, mitigation kept apart from the fix, the real root cause, and follow-up actions with owners.

rounds.label: Architecture evaluation
rounds.about: A mixed round grounded in a system context pack: one design, two API decisions, one incident.
rounds.instructions: Tie questions to the system in the context pack whenever it fits.
